O Portal Científico é uma plataforma bas: The Scientific Portal is a platform based on information from CiênciaVitae that promotes the integration and dissemination of scientific production by teachers and students at a Higher Education Institution (HEI). This platform aims to facilitate access and sharing of research, articles, projects and other scientific contributions, creating a collaborative and enriching environment for the advancement of knowledge.

O objetivo desta aplicação é promover a: The objective of this application is to promote the integration and dissemination of the scientific production of teachers and students from a Higher Education Institution (HEI), with the aim of facilitating access and sharing of research, articles, projects and other scientific contributions, creating an environment collaborative and enriching for the advancement of knowledge.
A aplicação usa algoritmos avançados par: The application uses advanced algorithms to receive users and their scientific articles, from CienciaVitae, so that users can later interact with the collected data, from searching for authors, articles, <cite>Keywords</cite>, among others, through a system Advanced filtering/search.

O Portal Científico foi concebido para c: The Scientific Portal was designed to centralize, validate, and disseminate the scientific production of professors and researchers at ISLA Gaia. Through automated API integrations with CiênciaVitae, the platform ensures the interoperability of academic profiles and the continuous curation of curriculum data.
Proporciona ferramentas de análise métri: It provides metric analysis tools (Scopus and Web of Science indexing, SJR/JCR quartiles, and CEOS.PP indicators), streamlining both faculty performance evaluations and institutional reporting and auditing for accreditation bodies.
Alinhado com as políticas de Ciência Abe: Aligned with Open Science policies and regional socioeconomic and scientific development, the portal promotes transparency and highlights the impact of publications and projects across the higher education ecosystem.

Ao colaborar no Portal Científico, é cru: When collaborating on the Scientific Portal, it is crucial that author profiles are filled in with rigor and completeness. The integrity of this information ensures proper aggregation on the platform, accuracy of institutional statistics, and compliance for faculty performance evaluation.
8.1 Domínios de Atuação para a Definição: 8.1 Fields of Activity for Profile Definition
Ao definir o perfil do autor, é fundamen: When defining the author\u0027s profile, it is essential to accurately fill in the fields of activity, providing specific information:
Selecione a área que melhor representa o: Select the area that best represents your field of activity for institutional categorization purposes.
Especifique o tópico específico na área: Specify the specific topic within the chosen field to provide a refined definition of your specialization.
Introduza termos que descrevam com exati: Enter terms that accurately describe your interests, research, and skills to facilitate search and the creation of collaborative networks.
O preenchimento do percurso profissional: Filling out the professional background reflects academic and institutional responsibilities. Mandatory and recommended fields:
Indique Ciência, Docência no Ensino Supe: Indicate Science, Higher Education Teaching, or Positions and Functions, specifying full-time, part-time, etc.
Selecione o ISLA-IPGT e descreva o tipo: Select ISLA-IPGT and describe the type of professional link and category.
Mantenha a data de fim em branco caso se: Leave the end date blank if you are currently in office.
Associe orientações de teses, comissões: Associate thesis supervisions, evaluation committees, academic degree juries, and event scientific committees.
Para projetos de investigação financiado: For funded or institutional research projects:
Importe sempre o DOI ou código de financ: Always import the DOI or official project funding code (e.g., FCT, POCH, Horizon Europe).
Distinga entre Investigador Principal (P: Distinguish between Principal Investigator and Collaborator, since the faculty evaluation system differentiates project leadership.
Registe o centro de investigação de acol: Register the host research center and the funding program.
8.4 Preenchimento dos Campos dos Outputs: 8.4 Filling out Output Fields (Articles, Books, Conferences)
Sempre que disponível, inclua o DOI numé: Whenever available, include the numerical DOI or permanent link. The Scientific Portal uses the DOI to correlate Scopus citations and quartiles.
Identifique corretamente se o output est: Correctly identify whether the output is "Published", "Accepted", "In review", or "Submitted".
Classifique com precisão entre Artigo em: Accurately classify as Journal Article, Book, Book Chapter, Conference Article, or Poster.
Escolha palavras-chave específicas e nor: Choose specific and standardized keywords to facilitate thematic indexing in search engines and central repository filters.
Registe todos os co-autores e associe o: Register all co-authors and associate their respective Ciência ID whenever available. This avoids duplicate publications in the institutional repository and ensures attribution of collaborative work.
Descreva detalhadamente tarefas de arbit: Describe in detail peer review tasks, participation in juries, and conference organization. These activities are automatically imported by the Scientific Portal to populate faculty evaluation reports (CEOS / Quality).
Os metadados foram agregados a partir do: Metadata was aggregated from CiênciaVitae and validated by the scientific quality team at ISLA Gaia.
Os dados apresentados são sincronizados: The displayed data is synchronized from the official CiênciaVitae API (FCT) according to the information filled in by faculty in their public profiles.
